Evaluate the following resume against the job description and provide a detailed ATS (Applicant Tracking System) compliance analysis. Return a structured JSON evaluation including ATS score, score breakdown, matched skills, missing skills, weak bullet analysis with improvements, formatting issues, and overall feedback.

### Input:
RESUME:
Alex Kim
Frontend Developer | alex.kim@email.com | Portfolio: alexkim.dev

EXPERIENCE
Senior Frontend Developer, PixelPerfect Inc - Apr 2021 - Present
- Engineered responsive web application serving 2M monthly active users
- Reduced page load time by 45% through code splitting and lazy loading
- Built reusable component library used by 15 developers across 4 teams
- Implemented end-to-end testing with Cypress achieving 90% coverage

Frontend Developer, DigitalAgency - Jul 2019 - Mar 2021
- Developed websites for various clients using React
- Responsible for converting Figma designs to pixel-perfect code
- Worked on fixing cross-browser compatibility issues
- Participated in code reviews and team meetings

EDUCATION
B.S. Computer Science, University of Technology - 2019

SKILLS
JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue.js, CSS/SASS, Tailwind, Webpack, Cypress, Jest

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Full Stack Developer
WebDynamics Inc.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of full stack experience
- JavaScript/TypeScript proficiency
- React or Angular experience
- Backend with Node.js or Python (Django/Flask)
- Database experience (PostgreSQL, MongoDB)
- RESTful API design
- Git proficiency
- Cloud deployment experience

Nice to have:
- GraphQL experience
- Microservices architecture
- Payment integrations

Responsibilities:
- Develop end-to-end features
- Design and implement APIs
- Write comprehensive tests
- Participate in agile processes
